title: docs(client, cli): say environments activate writes no server state
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9PMDzvc5jP3MDLgvgcsqgUY)_
Fixes #31783

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：SDK `environments.activate` 的注释、环境接口列表，以及 CLI `os environments switch` / `create` 的注释、`--remote` 说明和 `--no-remote` 提示，改为如实描述：这个调用只确认调用者是该环境成员，不写任何服务器状态。
- 为什么改：原文说服务器会把当前环境写进会话，实际上 cloud 的路由什么都不写（回 `sessionUpdated: false`）；当前环境只存在 CLI 本地的 credentials 里。
- 风险与回滚：只改注释、flag 说明和一行提示文字，行为不变。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/cli/src/commands/environments/switch.ts`（flag 说明与提示）、`packages/client/src/index.ts`（`activate` 的 jsdoc）、`packages/cli/src/commands/environments/create.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`git grep -n -E "session row|server session|server-side session|active_environment_id" packages/client/src packages/cli/src/commands/environments`，预期无输出。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Option A of the card, wording only. Every place in `packages/client` and `packages/cli` that said the server writes or switches the session's active environment now says what happens: the `/activate` call reads the environment, confirms the caller is a member of it, and writes no server state; the active environment lives in the CLI's local credentials.

Places changed (line numbers on head `dd02a89c`):

1. `packages/client/src/index.ts:3389`: the environments endpoint list (card place 1).
2. `packages/client/src/index.ts:3703-3711`: the `environments.activate` jsdoc (card place 2). It also says the answer carries `sessionUpdated: false` and that the CLI keeps the active environment locally and sends it per request (`X-Environment-Id`).
3. `packages/cli/src/commands/environments/switch.ts:15-18`: the command's doc comment (card place 3), plus `:21-22`, one added sentence that the active environment lives only in the local files.
4. `packages/cli/src/commands/environments/switch.ts:52`: the `--remote` flag description, now `Also call /activate on the server to confirm access (writes no server state)` (card place 4).
5. `packages/cli/src/commands/environments/switch.ts:76`: the code comment (card place 5).
6. `packages/cli/src/commands/environments/switch.ts:110`: the `--no-remote` note, now `(local only — /activate was not called)` (card place 6, user-visible text; FAIL round 1 replaced an inaccurate first wording, since `environments.get` has already resolved the environment on the server by then).
7. Further hits from the delta's grep (ruling 1), same claim in `packages/cli`: `packages/cli/src/commands/environments/create.ts:25-27` (doc comment) and `:125` (code comment, "the server session is already switched").

The grep ran over `packages/client` and `packages/cli` for `active_environment_id`, "session row", "server session", "server-side session", `sessionUpdated` and "session's active environment". Left as they are: `packages/cli/src/commands/logout.ts:29` ("Revoke server-side session", a real server write, unrelated), the `sessionUpdated` field in the `activate` return type (the wire shape), and `client.environments-namespace.test.ts:333-342`, which relays a stub envelope with `sessionUpdated: true` to pin pass-through and says nothing about what the server does.

No code path, flag or default changes. `--remote` stays default-on (option B not taken).

Changeset: `.changeset/31783-environments-activate-wording.md`, patch for `@objectstack/client` and `@objectstack/cli`. Rule followed: AGENTS.md Post-Task Checklist step 3 and os-dev's published-surface test. The client jsdoc ships in the published `.d.ts`, and the flag description and the `--no-remote` note ship in the CLI's help and output, so this is not the comments-only fast lane.

The `--remote` description is not snapshot-tested and appears in no generated doc or help file (`git grep` for the old texts outside `switch.ts`: zero hits), so nothing was regenerated. `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx:3137-3138` already describes switch and create as local-only and needs no change.

## Tests

No test changes. No test pins the old texts.

## Acceptance notes

- Option B (drop the default-on `/activate` call) is not in this PR. `switch` already calls `environments.get` on the same id just before `/activate`, so the default call adds a second access check and nothing else. Seat ruling at review: no card for B.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck`, then `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit --maxWorkers=2`: `Test Files 406 passed (406)`, `Tests 5777 passed (5777)`. One lock run for the client and cli legs: `VERDICT command-exit 0`. The integration tier is left to CI (no integration or spawn-entry file touched).
- `eslint --no-inline-config` on the three touched files: exit 0 (re-run on `switch.ts` at `dd02a89c`: exit 0) (neither package has its own lint script).
</details>

On the first round, four gates first answered exit 3 (prerequisite not met: the teardown self-test fixture commit, and dist for the dual-build, i18n-coverage and skill-examples gates). They went green after fetching the fixture commit and building packages and examples.

No ablation: wording only, no tested behaviour changed.
